scope: D7 delta f4f223414..worktree (commits 5bbb23682, b20962b4f plus the uncommitted callers); D18 header removals ignored. srv-05.detail: Command, secret file helper and seeder no longer hardcode a password; the switch reads config('services.codemart_seed_demo') (LaravelConfig, D17) and the comment is corrected. Two defects: (1) a generated secret is never applied to accounts that already exist, so the printed password does not work and the removed published password stays valid; (2) the generated password goes to the seeder log callback, which the initializer wires to Log::info.

cmdesign-03-api.detail: testimonial and reviewer_application groups, terminal_states, capability_roles and policy.withdrawal_methods/withdrawal_min_amount are served by GET /api/codemart/v1/bootstrap and equal the constants. terminal_states has no analysis or submission group, so ui-codemart cmdesign-03 cannot drop CmProjectAnalysisPanel.tsx:12 or CmSubmissionsPanel.tsx:15, which the dependent item names.

CKA-28 (ledger codes).detail: appendLedger stores description_code + description_params. Every credit/debit/freeze/unfreeze/settleFrozen caller passes a LEDGER_* code: 13 codes, 13 en and zh_CN keys. The transaction model translates by code in the request locale, and legacy rows keep their stored text. The literal-message sweep in the same item (RegistrationCtl:70, ProjectCtl:220, 33 English CodeMartV1FinanceException messages, ...) is not in this delta and stays open for G1.

Initializer contract columns.detail: codemart_v1_wallet_transactions.description_code (varchar, null) and description_params (json, null) are aligned idempotently. codemart_v1_ai_analyses.accept_idempotency_key (CodeMartV1Initializer.php:414) has no reader or writer until cmgap-U30 lands.

issues: CodeMartV1DemoSeeder.php:756-761,855: when CodeMartV1AdminPassword::ensure() generates the secret file, existing seeded accounts keep their old hash (seedAccounts only hashes new users). The password that sys:init prints is rejected, and the removed published password keeps working. Rolled-back probe on the local DB: 0/7 accounts accept the generated password and 7/7 still accept the removed literal. Fix: when $secret['generated'] is true, call CodeMartV1AdminPassword::apply($secret['password']) after seedAccounts, reusing the command's applier (D17 and contract purpose: 'applied to the database at once'). When the file already exists, keep today's behaviour: the seeder never rehashes and only codemart:admin-password rotates. Verify: after seed with a missing scratch file, 7/7 accept it and 0/7 accept the removed literal; a second seed changes 0 hashes.

CodeMartV1DemoSeeder.php:758 with CodeMartV1Initializer.php:564: the generated password is passed to the seeder $log callback, which sys:init wires to Log::info. The plaintext secret ends up in laravel.log (syslog on the server). The probe captured 1 log message carrying it. Fix: the seeder logs only codemart.cli.seed.password_file (path). The password stays in the returned summary, which the console printers (initializer step message, sys:codemartinit) already use.

CodeMartV1Constants.php:786-797 (contractVocabulary terminal_states): add the analysis and submission groups from existing constants so that ui-codemart cmdesign-03 can derive its local sets. analysis: [completed, failed], whose non-terminal states pending/processing/revising equal CmProjectAnalysisPanel.tsx:12. submission: [approved, needs_revision, rejected], whose non-terminal states equal SUBMISSION_REVIEWABLE_STATUSES (CodeMartV1Constants.php:585). Also add SUBMISSION_STATUS_PENDING to states.submission (:725-730): the check constraint (CodeMartV1Initializer.php:202), SUBMISSION_REVIEWABLE_STATUSES and BootstrapService.php:291 all use it, but the vocabulary omits it. Declare the two lists as named constants next to the other *_TERMINAL_STATUSES.
non_blocking: CodeMartV1Constants.php:786: the comment says terminal_states are 'states from which no further transition exists'. PROJECT_TRANSITIONS allows completed -> archived and cancelled -> archived. The values match the UI CLOSED_* sets, so keep them and reword the comment as closed states (no further work).

CodeMartV1Initializer.php:414: accept_idempotency_key has no reader or writer. cmgap-U30 (G1) must use it, or drop it from the contract structure. The column already exists locally; do not drop it, because that is destructive.

CodeMartV1AdminPassword.php:32,88: the RuntimeException messages are English literals and reach the sys:init step output through initialize()'s catch. Move them to codemart lang keys in the G1 literal sweep.

CodeMartV1AdminPassword.php:59: Str::random(24) is used instead of the InstallationAccessCode helper that the ruling names. Accepted: InstallationAccessCode exposes no generator (its placeholder is private and NEXU-shaped). Str::random is the framework helper, so no new generator was written. Its output [A-Za-z0-9] is a subset of the contract's base64url alphabet, and the length of 24 was verified.

CodeMartV1AdminPassword.php:68-69: writeFile + ensureFileMode repeat FileSystemManager::writePrivateFile with the mode taken from the contract. Optional: reuse writePrivateFile when the contract mode is 0600.

decisions: Blocking fix 1 overrides the item's literal 'never rehashes an existing account' only for the generated-file case. Reason: D17 and the contract require the printed password to work at once, and applying through CodeMartV1AdminPassword::apply keeps a single rotation implementation.
The log leak is raised from the coordinator's non-blocking to blocking. It writes a plaintext credential to a log file, and the fix is one line.
The analysis/submission terminal groups are blocking because cmdesign-03-api exists to let ui-codemart drop exactly those local sets.
